en.title: Migratory Birds of the Void Route: Chronicles of the Silver Wind Fleet
en.premise: The 'Star Roads,' dormant for millennia, have suddenly reactivated. As interstellar travel efficiency skyrockets, the balance of power across the sector collapses. Amidst fierce fleet battles for control over strategic 'Nodes,' diplomats weave a web of secret pacts and betrayals in sleepless trading cities. Meanwhile, a lone reconnaissance ship uncovers a forbidden truth: the Star Roads are actually the remnants of a 'Great Migration' left behind by an ancient intelligent civilization.

zh.title: 虚空航路之候鸟 ―银风舰队记―
zh.premise: 沉睡数千年的“星路”突然重启，星系间的移动效率大幅提升，导致星域内的势力均衡走向崩溃。在围绕军事要冲“节点（Node）”展开的激烈舰队战中，外交官们在不夜的贸易都市里周旋于密约与背叛之间。而一艘侦察舰，却意外触及了禁忌的真相——星路的本质，竟是昔日智慧生命体留下的“大迁徙（Migration）”遗迹。
